_note: Banco Horizonte: a FICTITIOUS bank, for the bank onboarding demonstration (apps/demo-onboarding).
Every identifier here is a TEST placeholder that no Registrar assigned. TEST environment only.
Claim names are the PID Rulebook v1.1 SD-JWT VC ones (scripts/pid/pid-rulebook-sd-jwt.json).
There is no age claim: the PID has none (CLAUDE.md §6.1). The bank receives the date of birth,
which its onboarding needs anyway, and works out the person's majority from it.
The address claims are optional in the Rulebook, and a query naming a claim the credential lacks
matches no credential: a test PID for this demonstration must carry all four.

policy.name: Banco Horizonte — customer onboarding with PID
policy.description: Identifies a new customer from their PID: names, date of birth, nationalities, personal administrative number and address. Nothing else is asked for.
